name: application-matrix-question-grid
title: Matrix Question Grid
description: Survey matrix question: a table of statement rows against a shared response-scale column set (e.g. Strongly disagree through Strongly agree), each row an independent radio group.
useWhen: Collecting single-choice ratings for multiple statements against one shared scale in a survey or feedback form.
You want to render this as a compact table rather than repeating a full radio group per statement.
Distinct from Notification Preferences Grid, which pairs channels against event types with checkboxes for independent multi-select toggles, not a single-choice rating scale shared across statements.
avoidWhen: Toggles are independent per cell (multi-select) rather than one choice per row — use Notification Preferences Grid instead.
There's only one statement to rate — a single rating scale is simpler than a full matrix.
responsiveBehavior: The statement column keeps 40% width so scale labels stay aligned across rows; on very narrow viewports the table scrolls horizontally within its container rather than reflowing.
accessibility: Every radio input carries an aria-label combining the row statement and column label, since the visible column header is shared across all rows rather than repeated per cell.
Each row's radios share a unique name attribute, giving native single-choice-per-row keyboard and screen reader behavior.
The table uses scope="col"/scope="row" so assistive tech announces the correct statement and scale label for any focused cell.

variants.title: Matrix Question Grid
variants.description: Three statements rated on a 5-point Strongly disagree to Strongly agree scale, each with a different pre-selected response.
accessibility: Each radio's aria-label states both the statement and the scale point it represents.

variants.title: Matrix Question Grid (Dark)
variants.description: The same matrix question adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Radio and header text contrast remain distinguishable at dark-surface contrast.
